clue.text: Drunken flirting in game?

parts.note: tiddly is British slang for slightly drunk
winks are a flirt's glances, so flirting can be winks

explanation.surface: A tipsy player making eyes at others during a game.
explanation.definitionFit: A children's game of flicking small counters into a cup, so it is an example of a game.

clue.text: Friar's at home and eats heartily

parts.note: Friar Tuck of the Robin Hood legend, with the possessive kept
in means at home

explanation.surface: A friar is at home, having a hearty meal.
explanation.walkthrough: TUCK IN is British for eating eagerly; Friar Tuck is famously fond of food.
explanation.definitionFit: A phrasal verb meaning eats with enthusiasm.

clue.text: An air of sadness

parts.note: air means a tune rather than an atmosphere

explanation.surface: A melancholy mood.
explanation.definitionFit: A mournful song for the dead is literally a sad tune.

clue.text: Cobbler's farewell ceremony?

parts.note: a cobbler's last is the shoe-shaped form; the rites for the dying are the final sacrament

explanation.surface: A shoemaker's retirement party.
explanation.definitionFit: The final sacraments given to the dying, punning on the cobbler's tool.

clue.text: Northern river sport

definitions.meaning: the river flowing through Durham and Sunderland in north-east England
to sport clothing is to have it on

explanation.surface: Water sport on a river in the north.
explanation.definitionFit: A river in north-east England, and a verb for having clothes on.

clue.text: French leader turned an East European on

indicators.note: turned means the word an is read backwards

parts.note: a Pole is from Poland
taken as written

explanation.surface: A French ruler turning on an Eastern European.
explanation.definitionFit: Bonaparte was the emperor who led France.

clue.text: Location in sound and vision

indicators.note: in sound means the word for location is said aloud

parts.note: a site is a location

explanation.surface: A place experienced through both hearing and eyesight.
explanation.walkthrough: 'sound and vision' looks like a pair of senses, but 'in sound' is the homophone signal.
explanation.definitionFit: The faculty of seeing, synonymous with eyesight.

clue.text: Turn gas up in a way, making pasta

indicators.note: up in, as in placed up inside, puts the turned word within the way

parts.note: a lane is a way or road

indicators.note: turn means the word gas is turned round to read backwards

explanation.surface: Turning up the gas on a stove to cook pasta.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Turn gas up' reads as raising a flame; 'Turn' reverses GAS to SAG and 'up in' places it within the way.
explanation.definitionFit: Flat sheets of Italian pasta, or the baked dish made from them.

clue.text: Treatment that is always on hand

definitions.text: Treatment that is always on hand

parts.words: Treatment that is always on hand
parts.note: on hand means literally applied to the hand, not readily available

explanation.surface: A remedy that is always ready.
explanation.definitionFit: A beauty treatment for the fingernails is applied to the hands.

clue.text: One can't be trusted after a deal is made

definitions.text: One can't be trusted after a deal is made

parts.words: One can't be trusted after a deal is made
parts.note: the deal is of playing cards, not a business agreement, and the untrustworthy one cheats at cards

explanation.surface: A warning that a business partner turns treacherous once the contract is signed.
explanation.definitionFit: A cheat at card games is untrustworthy once the cards have been dealt.

clue.text: Pot plant

definitions.meaning: pot is slang for cannabis, also called by this slang name
a green plant of lawns and meadows

explanation.surface: A houseplant sitting in a pot.
explanation.definitionFit: Slang for marijuana, and also the common herbage of fields and lawns.

clue.text: Make a mistake and throw out the drink

indicators.note: out, as in outside, puts the throw word around the mistake word

parts.note: to shy is to throw, as at a coconut shy
to err is to make a mistake

explanation.surface: Someone spills a drink and has to pour it away.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Throw out' reads as one phrasal verb, but 'throw' gives SHY and 'out' means the mistake goes inside it.
explanation.definitionFit: A fortified wine from Spain, so a kind of drink.

clue.text: Hamper holding spare garments

indicators.note: holding means the hamper word goes round the spare word

parts.note: to clog is to hamper or obstruct
spare can mean thin, lean

explanation.surface: A laundry hamper containing spare clothes.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Hamper' looks like a basket noun but is the verb CLOG.
explanation.definitionFit: Garments taken together are what one wears: apparel in general.

clue.text: Fine quality diamonds worn with a shirt in New York

indicators.note: in means the gems and shirt sit inside the city letters

parts.note: ice is slang for diamonds
a T-shirt gives T

explanation.surface: Diamonds worn with a casual shirt in Manhattan.
explanation.definitionFit: A subtle detail or fine distinction is a refinement, a delicate quality.

clue.text: Female guard of honour

parts.note: not a ceremonial guard but an older woman guarding a young woman's virtue

explanation.surface: A woman serving in a ceremonial guard.
explanation.definitionFit: An older woman escorting a young lady to protect her reputation.

clue.text: Mad party guest going to pot used room to spruce up

definitions.text: Mad party guest going to pot

indicators.note: sprucing something up rearranges and tidies it, so the letters are reordered

explanation.surface: A wild party guest cleans a room that has been used.
explanation.walkthrough: In Alice in Wonderland the sleepy guest at the Mad Hatter's tea party is stuffed into the teapot.
explanation.definitionFit: The drowsy rodent at the Mad Hatter's tea party ends up shoved into the teapot.

clue.text: Staff professor, first class, brought up in old country

parts.note: a mace is a ceremonial staff
a don is a university teacher

indicators.note: in a down clue brought up means read from the bottom upwards

parts.note: A1 means first class, with the 1 read as I

explanation.surface: Staff and a top professor raised in an ancient land.
explanation.walkthrough: A1, written AI, turns into IA.
explanation.definitionFit: The ancient kingdom of Philip and Alexander the Great in northern Greece.

clue.text: One doesn't believe in coasting freely

indicators.note: freely means the letters of coasting move about at will

explanation.surface: Someone sceptical of just drifting through life.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone who holds that God's existence cannot be known is a non-believer.

clue.text: It's an indication for drivers, by the way

definitions.text: It's an indication for drivers, by the way

parts.words: It's an indication for drivers, by the way
parts.note: 'by the way' reads as an aside but literally places the indication beside the road

explanation.surface: A casual remark that something is a hint for motorists.
explanation.definitionFit: Traffic notices stand at the roadside to direct motorists.

clue.text: Frauds seen in court or in the press

definitions.text: seen in court or in the press
definitions.meaning: the bats for a court game, kept flat in a frame called a press

explanation.surface: Scams exposed by the courts and reported in newspapers.
explanation.walkthrough: A press is a frame for keeping a tennis bat from warping; 'court' is a sports court.
explanation.definitionFit: Dishonest schemes, and the strung bats used on a court.

clue.text: Could be a good laugh or cry

explanation.surface: Something might make one laugh or weep.
explanation.definitionFit: Informally a very funny thing, and also a piercing shriek.

clue.text: Broods about one's exploits

indicators.note: about means the broods word goes round the next piece

parts.note: muses means broods or ponders
one's gives I (one) plus S

explanation.surface: Someone dwelling on past deeds.
explanation.walkthrough: 'exploits' looks like a noun but is a verb.
explanation.definitionFit: To take unfair advantage of something is to abuse it.

clue.text: Believe gold might satisfy him?

parts.note: to credit is to believe
or is the heraldic word for gold

explanation.surface: Trust that paying in gold will keep someone happy.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone owed money is satisfied when the lender is repaid, perhaps in gold.

clue.text: Articles in the Telegraph or Times possibly

indicators.note: possibly means the word Times may be rearranged

explanation.surface: Stories printed in one paper or its rival.
explanation.definitionFit: Newspaper pieces or reports are individual articles.

clue.text: Models must be fashionable ladies

indicators.note: fashionable hints at the word ladies being styled into a new shape

explanation.surface: Catwalk models are required to be stylish women.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Models' suggests fashion models; here it means perfect examples.
explanation.definitionFit: Standards of perfection serve as models to imitate.

clue.text: Excuse for being absent

parts.note: absent from the scene of a crime, not from work or school

explanation.surface: A note explaining missing work.
explanation.definitionFit: A claim of being elsewhere when a crime occurred.

clue.text: Payment before ascent of mountain

indicators.note: in a down clue an ascent means the mountain word is read upwards

parts.note: Etna is a mountain in Sicily

explanation.surface: A fee paid before climbing a peak.
explanation.definitionFit: A poker stake put in before the cards are dealt.

clue.text: Call up a woman, a case for approval

indicators.note: the woman's name forms a case around the approval word

parts.note: Eve is a woman's name
OK means approval

explanation.surface: Phoning a woman, a promising candidate for endorsement.
explanation.definitionFit: To summon or conjure a memory or feeling is to bring it to mind.

clue.text: Cat seen in various residences

indicators.note: various signals the letters appearing in a different arrangement

explanation.surface: A cat spotted at several homes.
explanation.definitionFit: Periods of occupying rented property, hence residences.

clue.text: Confidential sign which executives employ

parts.note: confidential means secret
Aries is a sign of the zodiac

explanation.surface: A confidential signal used by company bosses.
explanation.definitionFit: Office assistants are hired by managers to handle their correspondence.
